name: Sortabase
title: sortabase.com
shortDescription: Sortabase offers a platform for creating and managing visual, collaborative databases that are built and managed by communities. It allows users to engage with various topics ranging from technology to local activities, making it ideal for collaborative research and community-driven projects. An example use case is a community collectively managing a database of local activities in Toronto.
pros: Diverse range of topics and databases
cons: Limited to the topics available on the platform
